name: trader-vaults
description: Trader vaults on Solana — traders trade pooled capital they can never withdraw.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:push -w apps/api && npm run db:seed -w apps/api
scripts.build: node scripts/prisma-prod.mjs generate && npm run build -w apps/api --if-present && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.build:prod: npm install && node scripts/prisma-prod.mjs generate && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
